title: Ancient terrestrial civilization with near-luminal travel

plain: An advanced civilization may have lived on Earth hundreds of millions of years ago, possibly travelling at close to the speed of light, with all evidence later wiped away as the planet's surface was reshaped. Eric Haseltine, billed as a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US electronic spying agency, raises this on Michels' show as one of the ideas explored with Chris Gilbert in the book The New Science of UFOs.
